target.title: [codex] improve ClawHub diversion handoff
target.body:
## Summary

- rewrite the ClawHub diversion handoff onto current `main`
- explain the expected installable package shape, metadata, manifest basics, and self-service next steps
- keep ClawSweeper inside its repository boundary: no creating ClawHub issues, PRs, or packages on a contributor's behalf
- move the stale monolithic test into the current split policy suites and add prompt coverage
- add an Unreleased changelog entry thanking @brokemac79

## Current-main rewrite

The original branch conflicted only because `test/clawsweeper.test.ts` has since been split. The production behavior remains useful, and the assertions now live in `test/review-close-policy.test.ts` and `test/review-prompt-policy.test.ts` against current `main`.

Final diff: 5 files, +33/-2.

## Proof

- `pnpm run build:all`
- `node --test test/review-close-policy.test.ts test/review-prompt-policy.test.ts` — 50/50 passed
- `pnpm run check` — 600 unit tests and 596 repair tests passed
- changed coverage — 100.00% lines, 89.17% branches, 100.00% functions
- overall coverage — 76.64% lines, 70.59% branches, 83.86% functions
- formatting — clean across 295 files
- full-branch AutoReview — clean, confidence 0.91

## Risk

Low. This changes only the explanatory close comment for the `clawhub` route and its review prompt; it does not create or publish cross-repository work.
